scenario.title: Find, read, author and preserve work records
situations: The user cannot find an item or wants the history/spec/evidence behind its card.
Existing external tasks or documents should become useful Yoke work.
A draft is incomplete, its spec changes, or its current checkpoint must be preserved.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Trace item artifacts separately from QA artifacts, strategy renders and universe backups; similar names are not interchangeable.
Audit what first-draft readiness failures explain to the human versus fetch for the agent.

lessons.title: Find the authoritative record and ask for the needed part
lessons.when: When locating old/current work or moving from a summary card to its specification or evidence.
lessons.need: Search/list/detail/section reads answer different questions; item fields and Progress Logs are authoritative records, while board and rendered bodies are views.
lessons.surface: Items search/list/get/detail/section and Progress Log surfaces
lessons.gap: Existing operation references do not prove first-use discovery. Review question: should the human Work guide teach search-to-record-to-evidence with one real example?

lessons.title: Import intent without assuming a generic importer
lessons.when: When adopting external issues/documents or changing an item specification after intake.
lessons.need: Identify supported intake and typed artifact writes; preserve source provenance and existing IDs, duplicate checks, readiness and current evidence. Do not infer bulk-item import support from universe import.
lessons.surface: Idea intake/refine; typed structured fields; readiness adapters
lessons.gap: Help advertises item writes/search, but this pass did not verify a general item import or arbitrary attachment facility. Review question: what adoption formats and evidence links are actually supported, and which need instructions rather than new import code?
